top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, foundational account of collateral constraints and credit-friction amplification that has durably reshaped macroeconomic theory, quantitative work, and policy analysis. Kiyotaki, Moore, and Gertler provide a defensible core when the citation remains narrow, although Simon Gilchrist's important contribution remains a material attribution qualification.
recusal_note: My supplied profile discloses frequent coauthorship and institutional ties with Per Krusell and Timo Boppart, who support P001; it discloses no connection to P001's proposed laureates.
